indication: Erbitux is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with BRAF V600E mutant metastatic colorectal cancer in combination with encorafenib in patients who have received prior systemic therapy.
description: The European Medicines Agency (EMA) has authorized cetuximab in combination with encorafenib for the treatment of patients with BRAF V600E mutant metastatic colorectal cancer who have received prior systemic therapy.
